scope.local: A55/A56 and partial-handoff assertions use isolated local bare-Git, private file, and fake-secret-adapter fixtures.
scope.host: Host preservation evidence covers selected Linux configuration entries in the current WSL environment. It does not cover every service, live firewall state, Windows policy, or all host state.
scope.providers: A59 has separate actual fresh Codex and Claude sessions on isolated local Git authorities. These are provider-backed bootstrap runs, not GitHub hosting runs. A63 also has one actual fresh Claude Haiku 5.5 missing-secret turn on isolated local Git; the retained trace was revalidated and manually reviewed.
limitations: A58 is proven for one isolated Linux installed-launcher repair using the current source script; the original evidence wheel predates the repair module; the latest wheel now includes installed-SDK proof, and no comprehensive global host snapshot or arbitrary configuration repair is claimed.
A60 mutation fail-closed behavior is tested; readonly diagnostics for an incompatible protocol are not established and the current inspection path strictly parses protocol records.
A61/A62 partial-handoff tests call the runtime API with a fake secret adapter; the installed package smoke does not exercise partial secret handoff through the packaged CLI.
No full Design §25 completion claim is made.

classification_legend.proven_local: Executed assertions cover the stated local runtime or fixture requirement.
classification_legend.proven_hosting: An applicable real external provider/session run supplements the local assertions; scope is stated explicitly.
classification_legend.incomplete: A required integration, interaction, readonly behavior, or postcondition remains unproven.
classification_legend.unverified: No applicable executed evidence was found.
